name: Baga Beach Water Sports
description: Parasailing, jet-ski and banana boat rides operated by local vendors on Baga beach.

name: Chapora Fort Sunset Walk
description: A short walk up to Chapora Fort for panoramic sunset views over the Chapora river and Arabian sea.

name: Spice Plantation Tour
description: Guided tour of a working spice plantation with a traditional Goan lunch included.

name: Anjuna Flea Market
description: Famous Wednesday flea market with local handicrafts, clothing and street food stalls.

name: Pottery Workshop, Assagao
description: Small-group hands-on pottery session, a good indoor alternative on rainy days.

name: Sinquerim Fort Kayaking
description: Guided kayaking session near Sinquerim fort, best done in the calmer morning waters.

name: Cooking Class, Candolim
description: Hands-on Goan cooking class covering classic curries and a bebinca dessert, held indoors.

name: Casino Cruise, Panaji
description: Evening casino cruise on the Mandovi river, a popular indoor option regardless of weather.
